test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If Ojasvita received the following marks in five assignments: 82, 86, 92, 75 and 95, what is her average score?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the **assumed average** be 85.

Calculate **deviations** from 85: (82−85), (86−85), (92−85), (75−85), (95−85) → −3, +1, +7, −10, +10.

Sum of deviations = −3 + 1 + 7 − 10 + 10 = +5.

Average deviation = Total deviation ÷ Number of items = 5 ÷ 5 = +1.

Actual Average = Assumed Average + Average deviation = 85 + 1 = 86.

**∴ The correct answer is 86.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Marks in five assignments are 82, 86, 92, 75, and 95.

**Formula Used:** Average Score = Sum of all marks ÷ Total number of assignments

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ee4e0483b54135ea86cc89879ad7fff63475cfdf128d305ff3052b13a46aae6.png] 

⇒ Sum of marks = 82 + 86 + 92 + 75 + 95

⇒ Sum of marks = 430

⇒ Total number of assignments = 5

⇒ Average Score = 430 ÷ 5

⇒ Average Score = 86

**∴ The correct answer is 86.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean Property

The sum of the **deviations** of a set of observations from their **arithmetic mean** is always zero. ∑(xᵢ − x̄) = 0.

Effect of Constant Change

If a constant value 'k' is added to or subtracted from every observation in a data set, the new **average** will also increase or decrease by 'k'.

Weighted Average

When different values have different levels of importance, the **weighted average** is used: (∑wᵢxᵢ) ÷ ∑wᵢ.</p
